data.title: DPRK IT Worker Resume Geographic Mismatch
data.description: Detects job applicants whose resume combines a U.S. residential address with education credentials from non-North American institutions (Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, China, South Korea). This pattern is a key DPRK IT worker indicator documented by FBI IC3 and DOJ enforcement actions. Legitimate applicants with this profile exist, but the combination with thin credit files or recently created LinkedIn profiles significantly elevates risk.
falsepositives: Legitimate international students who studied abroad and relocated to the U.S.
H-1B visa holders with non-North American education backgrounds
Recent immigrants with legitimately thin credit histories
